newsitem.title: USA: Excess liquidity sends emerging market debt higher.
newsitem.headline: Excess liquidity sends emerging market debt higher.

text.p: Excess liquidity in the emerging debt market sent prices sharply higher Tuesday and trading sources said they believe the Brady market is poised to move even higher.

"It is unbelievably firm. There has been a lot of cash sitting around and we've been outperforming the U.S. Treasury market so a lot of people decided to buy," said a trader at a U.S. investment bank. He attibuted the steep rise to buying by both proprietary desks and investors.
